lines.say: If you're a med student, your Anki deck is probably a library with no librarian.
Thousands of cards, and no idea which ones actually matter for your exam.
Offload builds your cards from your own notes and syllabus, not someone else's deck.
It brings each one back right before you'd forget it. That's called spacing, and it's one of the most reliable findings in memory research.
And when you get one wrong, it books time in your calendar to re-learn it.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
